same: All kinds emit sparse evidence into the same strength enum
Gray / low margin → vague → human (never hard strong-Y)
strong_neg / missing → never write Y=human; hand off to PO+FN
Wash/missing is observationally shared by evade vs privacy vs OOD
diff: hard/soft_wm: p-value + robust probe; wash → gray
fingerprint: never strong_pos alone; high FP under OOD
user_declare: policy bit, not cryptographic recovery
missing: structural absence, not a negative test result

negative_effects.evade_intent: Adversary washes WM / strips api_log to spoof human — if treated as human, FN + poisoned uplift Y
negative_effects.privacy_intent: User/open-model redacts provenance / strips WM for privacy — same geometry as evade; sanctioning wash = trust/legal FP
negative_effects.uplift_misuse: Using WM as hard filter or pseudo-Y induces selection bias and label noise in R_PO / ATE; WM must stay gate+stratum

intent_routing.privacy: stratify; hold; never force Y=AI from absence

mvp_note: Six real-data watermark *forms* share one strength schema but differ in provenance power, wash robustness, and whether they may emit strong_pos. Gray→vague/human; neg/missing→PO+FN (never Y=human).
